title: The Check in panel writes the check-in link to an NFC tag from Chrome on Android, with a read-back check

source.ref: Owner request 2026-10-20 (program the tag from the website). ADR-1789

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. A Write to NFC tag button sits on the Check in code card. It uses Web NFC (Chrome on Android only), writes one URL record holding the link unchanged, then asks for a second tap and compares what it reads. Other browsers see where to program the tag instead.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const a=fs.readFileSync('components/spaces/checkin-nfc-writer.tsx','utf8');const b=fs.readFileSync('components/spaces/checkin-code-card.tsx','utf8');if(!a.includes('NDEFReader')||!a.includes('tagMatches')||!b.includes('CheckinNfcWriter')){console.error('LIVE-1113: no NFC write on the Check in card');process.exit(1)}"
